messages.author: c102ef7f5617067f
messages.subject: Automatically detect bird sound
parts:
I have many large .wav files of bird song. Each file is about 1GB and 3hrs long. Instead of me scrolling through the spectrograms of each file, I'm wondering if it's possible for seewave to automatically detect the bird song. Is it possible for seewave to either take me to the point in the file where the bird song is present or extract each portion of bird song and save it in new .wav files that contain only the bird song?

Many thanks in advance

messages.author: 65c82d09eac308cf
messages.subject: Re: [seewave] Automatically detect bird sound
parts:
Dear ??,

The function to do automatic detection is timer() but it is based on a rather simple threshold principle and will probably be difficult to handle with so large files.
Another solution could be to have a look at the package monitoR that processes automatic identification based on template matching.
Best
Jerome
